| What runs in the recovery Region | nothing — backups only, redeployed via CloudFormation at recovery time | DynamoDB/S3 data replicated and kept current; Lambda/API Gateway/Step Functions not deployed until failover |
| Cost | low | medium |

Backup and restore is enough if an hours-long outage is tolerable. Pilot light is the next step up if the business needs the API back in under an hour with near-current data. Either way, a recovery Region needs to be chosen first (see the residency question above) — nothing below depends on it until it's decided.
